title: Finalise witness list for R v Smith
description: Review all witness statements and confirm the final list of witnesses to be called for the trial. Liaise with prosecution counsel.

title: File defence in Jones v Acme Ltd
description: The deadline for filing the defence is approaching. Complete the final draft and ensure it is filed with the court and served on the claimant's solicitors.

title: Review expert report for Patel v NHS Trust
description: The expert medical report has been received. Review it in detail and prepare a summary for the client and counsel.

title: Prepare for annual CPD requirements
description: Review current CPD log and plan remaining courses for the year to meet SRA requirements. This is an ongoing task.

title: Draft witness statement for R v Smith
description: Draft the primary witness statement for A. Walker based on their preliminary interview. Focus on the timeline of events.

title: Prepare skeleton argument for R v Mitchell
description: Draft the skeleton argument for the upcoming criminal trial. Key authorities: R v Ghosh and R v Woollin. File by October 20th.

title: Mediation prep for Williams v Brightstar
description: Prepare position statement and bundle for the court-ordered mediation scheduled for mid-October. Anticipate counter-offer on quantum.

title: Appeal bundle for Nakamura v GlobalTech
description: Assemble the appeal bundle and ensure all key documents are paginated. Coordinate with the Court of Appeal listing officer.

title: Follow up on Thompson v TechCorp compensation
description: Chase the defendant's solicitors for payment of the £30,000 compensation award. Deadline for compliance has passed.

title: File defence witness statements - R v Smith
description: Finalise and file the defence witness statements with the Crown Court. Confirm service on the prosecution.

title: Complete client meeting notes - Brown v Brown
description: Write up notes from the client consultation regarding financial disclosure. Send summary to the client for review.

title: Submit quarterly time recording
description: Submit Q3 time sheets and expense claims to the accounts department. Cross-check with client billing records.

title: Order trial bundle - Jones v Acme
description: Instruct the court copy service to prepare the trial bundle. Include all pleadings, witness statements and expert reports.

title: Review new CPR amendments
description: Read through the Civil Procedure Rule updates effective October 2026. Note any changes affecting ongoing cases.

title: Schedule: Ongoing professional development
description: Long-term goal: complete two advanced litigation courses and one mediation workshop by year-end.
